title: Knockback FFA
description: This project is a Paper Plugin for the newest version of Minecraft that adds a PVP Fun Game where you kick Players of the Platform
body:
# **KNOCKBACK FFA**

A fast-paced **Knockback Free-For-All plugin** featuring statistics, ranks, and competitive gameplay.

---

## 📸 **Preview**

### 📜 Commands List

![Commandslist](https://r2.e-z.host/f0438ba5-b867-4420-a57c-e30f38b98639/hg251gr4.png)

![HologramTopKills](https://r2.e-z.host/f0438ba5-b867-4420-a57c-e30f38b98639/kup9k6k6.png)

---

## ⚙️ **Features**

* Knockback-based Free-For-All system
* **Built-in rank system**
* Player statistics (kills, deaths, etc.)
* Top kills hologram
* Live scoreboard with stats
* Clean & simple command system

---

## 🛠 **Configuration**

The plugin includes a **fully editable `config.yml` and `messages.yml`**
to customize the plugin exactly to your needs.

✔ Change all messages
✔ Configure ranks & stats
✔ Adjust gameplay settings
✔ Easy setup

---

## Setup

1. Set the spawn point using
   `/knockbackffa setspawn`

2. Go to one **upper corner** of your arena and run
   `/knockbackffa setarea 1`

3. Go to the **opposite lower corner** of the arena and run
   `/knockbackffa setarea 2`

4. Reconnect to the server and **have fun playing**!

5. *(Optional)* Set the **Top Kills hologram** using
   `/knockbackffa sethologram`
   *(Requires the DecentHolograms plugin)*

---

## 🌍 **Language**

⚠️ The plugin is originally written in **German**,
but **all messages can be changed manually**, allowing full translation to any language.
